ruling.recommended_action: Refer to RydeHELP manual review: re-extract the full GPS trace and reconcile the 14-minute stationary block and the post-Yuhua deviation, then recompute the metered-distance overcharge on the unexempted segment(s).

segment_findings.reason: Clementi-area deviation. Chat at 14:17:00 (rider asks to stop at Clementi Mall) and driver 'Ok' at 14:17:30 constitute passenger-named-stop consent under RD-3(a)/RD-5, so the off-route distance to the named stop is exempt if it matches the detour. But the trace is thinned to 30 s (0.2 km noise) and shows ~14 min stationary near Clementi (14:23:15–14:27:45) against the rider's stated '3-4 minutes', and the route polyline does not reach the stop at all. On this record the segment cannot be measured or delimited (RD-2/G12); not exempt per se — requires human verification.

Deviation after the stop. Thin GPS puts the vehicle outside the 0.2 km corridor of the quoted route from ~14:28:15 to 14:30:15 (Clementi Rd → Commonwealth Ave West → Toh Tuck), i.e. a leg back up north-west before re-joining near AYE. No chat message covers or consents to any route change beyond the named stop (RD-5), and no traffic incident or band 1-2 on the replaced segment supports a 'reasonable cause' exemption (RD-4(a)/(b)); the AYE band 4 window is on the quoted route and cannot exempt it. The size and existence of this extra mileage cannot be confirmed at 30 s sampling (G12), so the segment is undetermined → escalate.

rejected_claims.reason: Directionally plausible — the metered fare implies 10.55 km / 16.25 min against a 8.569 km quote, and the trace shows an unexplained stationary block and a post-stop deviation — but the thinned GPS (30 s, 50 m resolution) makes the extra mileage uncertain and the deviation legs unattributable. Claim neither upheld nor dismissed.

Consistent with the chat as to the Clementi stop, but it does not account for the ~14 min stationary period or the post-stop deviation seen in the trace, and a driver's account of verbal agreement cannot supply RD-5 consent (G11).
